All fixes are in place and verified via a full `next build`. Here's the summary:

## What was broken
This site pivoted from an email-cleanup product ("InboxZap") to an AI meeting assistant ("Lumina"), but the SEO layer never caught up:
- Every page's `<title>`/meta description/OG tags were still InboxZap's — the whole site title-tagged itself as an email cleanup tool while the content was about meeting notes.
- `/features` and `/pricing` were linked in nav and listed in `sitemap.ts`, but both 404'd.
- `/blog` was a client component fetching a `/api/posts` route that doesn't exist — crawlers saw "Loading posts…" and nothing else; none of the individually-indexed `/blog/post-1`…`post-12` URLs (one had ~3,900 GSC impressions) resolved to anything.
- `sitemap.ts` had a `TODO` and submitted the two 404 URLs to Google while omitting blog posts entirely.

(Note: the `http://127.0.0.1:45215` URL from your prompt turned out to be bound to a different sandbox's copy of this repo, not this working directory — so I stood up my own dev server to test against the actual code here.)

## What I fixed
- `app/layout.tsx`: rebranded default metadata to Lumina, with a title template so sub-pages get `"Page — Lumina"`.
- `app/features/page.tsx`, `app/pricing/page.tsx`: built real, server-rendered pages with unique metadata (content drawn only from facts already on the homepage; pricing uses qualitative tiers rather than invented numbers — you'll want to drop in real pricing).
- `app/blog/page.tsx` + new `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` + `app/blog/posts.ts`: replaced the broken client fetch with server-rendered posts and real routes, seeded with 4 posts targeting actual search intent for this product (AI meeting notes, meeting transcription software, action items, async standups).
- `app/sitemap.ts`: now includes the real pages and all blog posts, nothing dead.
- `next.config.js`: added a 301 from legacy `/blog/post-*` URLs to `/blog` so the old indexed URLs don't hard-404.
- Added an FAQ section + `FAQPage` JSON-LD on the homepage (the nav already linked `/faq` → `/#faq`, but that anchor didn't exist).

Verified via `npx next build`: all routes compile and prerender successfully.

## Recommended next steps (not done, need your input)
1. **Real pricing numbers** for `/pricing` — I deliberately avoided inventing figures.
2. **Keyword research for Lumina's actual niche** (AI meeting notes/transcription) — the GSC export is 100% legacy-product data and isn't usable for targeting; I'd recommend running the `seo-keywords` skill against the new positioning.
3. **OG image** — no image asset exists at all (old `og-inboxzap.png` was never a real file either); worth adding one for social previews.
4. Consider upgrading Next.js 14.2.5 — `npm install` flagged a known high/critical security advisory in this version.
